Add-Ons

Extend mabl's core capabilities with the following add-ons:

Advanced AI

Boost efficiency and software quality with advanced generative AI-powered capabilities that further reduce the time and effort required to create, expand, and maintain comprehensive test coverage. Includes features like Test Creation Agent and Auto Test Failure Analysis (Auto TFA).

Advanced Content Validation

Extend test coverage by including email and PDF testing within your end-to-end tests. Validate user journeys involving email registrations, confirmation, contact form submissions, and file sending to email addresses. Automate PDF validation to ensure accuracy in crucial documents like invoices or eBooks with assertions against PDF content akin to web application element validation.

Technical Account Manager

Accelerate adoption with a mabl Technical Account Manager (TAM), a dedicated technical advisor who enables effective and efficient adoption of mabl at scale. Gain exclusive access to dedicated product experts for hands-on guidance to build your testing strategy, and access additional training and best practices directly from mabl experts to achieve faster ROI.

FAQs
What is the pricing model for mabl?

mabl offers a transparent and flexible pricing model tailored to your testing requirements. Our pricing is designed to be simple, scalable, and customized to suit the needs of organizations, providing cost-effective solutions for various testing needs.

Do you offer custom plans for larger enterprises?

Yes, mabl provides custom plans specifically tailored for larger enterprises. Our pricing model is scalable, accommodating the diverse testing needs of organizations of all sizes. We work closely with enterprises to ensure that their requirements are met effectively.

Are there any setup fees or hidden charges?

No, mabl is committed to transparency in pricing. There are no setup fees or hidden charges. Our pricing structure is straightforward, allowing you to budget effectively and focus on your testing initiatives without unexpected costs.

How does mabl’s pricing model help me scale testing?

mabl's pricing model facilitates seamless scalability in testing efforts. You can pay once and share mabl across all capabilities, including browser and mobile UI, API, accessibility, and performance testing. Unlimited local test runs at no extra cost enable your development teams to run mabl tests for free after each commit or pull-request, effectively shifting testing left. And with unlimited cloud concurrency, mabl enables your team to get the fastest feedback from regression test suites at no extra cost.

What core capabilities are included for all mabl customers?

All mabl customers benefit from comprehensive core capabilities, including end-to-end testing for either mobile or browser UI, end-to-end API testing, unlimited local and CI tests, core AI capabilities, performance and accessibility testing, and seamless integrations with developer workflow and collaboration tools.

What support options are available with mabl?

mabl provides extensive support options, including live 24x5 support in English and Japanese, a designated Customer Success Manager (CSM) for personalized onboarding and ongoing expertise, and a Technical Account Manager (at additional cost) for technical and strategic guidance. We are committed to ensuring our customers receive the support they need.

How are credits consumed?

Credits are consumed based on your usage of cloud test runs. mabl provides a starting point of 500 credits per month for cloud test runs, shared across browser and mobile UI and API testing as well as performance and accessibility testing. This allows you to manage your testing resources effectively and optimize credit usage according to your testing needs. Note that local test runs are free.

Is there a free trial available?

Yes, mabl offers a 14-day free trial to allow users to experience our platform firsthand. The trial period provides an opportunity to explore all features and capabilities of mabl, ensuring that it aligns with your testing requirements before making a commitment.

How often do you release updates and new features?

The mabl product team uses modern development processes to continuously release improvements and new features. In 2024, mabl delivered more than 50 feature releases and over 1000 production deployments, covering areas such as Generative AI auto-healing and intelligent assertions, Mobile testing, Performance testing, AI-powered Database testing and query generation, and integration with Playwright. Already in 2025, we've made significant feature enhancements to our AI capabilities across the entire testing lifecycle, including test generation for web, mobile, and APIs, test failure summaries, and natural language flow search. Our users can expect frequent updates to ensure they have access to the latest tools and innovations in the testing landscape.

mabl, the leading AI-native test automation platform, empowers software teams to accelerate innovation while ensuring exceptional quality. Our agentic tester complements your team’s human expertise with a digital teammate, providing comprehensive and reliable quality assurance across web, mobile, and APIs. Trusted by industry leaders like Workday, Vivid Seats, and JetBlue, mabl transforms how teams approach software quality.
